# Breadcrumb

> The trail of links to the current page, as an ordered list in a navigation landmark. Separators are yours to add.

`<slab-breadcrumb>` · Navigation · built on `<nav> + <ol>`

Docs: https://slab-elements.dev/components/breadcrumb/

## Import

```js
import 'slab-elements/breadcrumb.js';
```

## Usage

```html
<slab-breadcrumb>
  <a href="/">Home</a>
  <a href="/docs/">Docs</a>
  <a href="/docs/install/">Install</a>
</slab-breadcrumb>
```

## Elements

### `<slab-breadcrumb>`

Import `slab-elements/breadcrumb.js` to register it.

A breadcrumb with no visual styles: a `<nav>` around an `<ol>` of the links slotted into it, the last of which is the current page.

An `<ol>` may only hold `<li>`s, so each slotted element gets an `<li>` of its own: it's put in a slot inside one, through the `slot` attribute, which Breadcrumb sets. The last element gets `aria-current="page"` unless it has an `aria-current` already.

Separators are a design's, so there are none. Each `<li>` is `::part(item)`, and every one but the first starts with a `::part(separator)`, which is hidden from screenreaders and has no content until you give it some. The `<ol>` keeps its numbers and indent until your styles take them off.

#### Attributes

| Name    | Type     | Default | Description                                               |
| ------- | -------- | ------- | --------------------------------------------------------- |
| `label` | `string` |         | Names the navigation. "Breadcrumb" in English when unset. |

#### Properties

| Name                | Type        | Description                  |
| ------------------- | ----------- | ---------------------------- |
| `items` (read-only) | `Element[]` | The slotted links, in order. |

#### Slots

| Name      | Type      | Description                                       |
| --------- | --------- | ------------------------------------------------- |
| (default) | `Element` | The links, from the first page to the current one |

#### CSS parts

| Name        | Description                                                 |
| ----------- | ----------------------------------------------------------- |
| `item`      | Each link's list item                                       |
| `list`      | The links                                                   |
| `nav`       | The navigation                                              |
| `separator` | What sits between two links, before every one but the first |
